title: Cost Accountant
summary: Cost accountants work out what each product costs to make in a factory and explain why actual costs differ from planned (standard) costs. They sit in the plant finance team, keep the cost records the law requires, and support the yearly cost audit.
dailyDuties: Prepare product cost sheets from BOMs and actual consumption
Analyse material, labour and overhead variances against standard costs
Value raw material, WIP and finished goods stock at month end
Run costing activities and settlements in the ERP
Prepare costing MIS for the plant head
Maintain cost records and answer cost auditor queries

skills.expectation: Prepare product and plant-wise cost sheets from BOMs, routings and actual consumption
Set and revise standard costs and explain material, labour and overhead variances
Maintain cost records and support the cost audit under the Companies (Cost Records and Audit) Rules
Value raw material, WIP and finished goods stock at month end
Allocate and absorb plant overheads through cost centres and machine hour rates
Run costing in SAP CO or a similar ERP costing module, including cost estimates and settlement
Prepare monthly costing MIS and budget-versus-actual reports for plant heads
Build cost workings and reconciliations in Excel
Help prepare the plant's annual cost budget
Reconcile cost records with the financial books
Give stock and cost schedules to statutory auditors
Use pivot tables and lookups on large consumption data
Explain cost movements to production and purchase teams

certifications.why: Shows hands-on knowledge of SAP management accounting (CO), where most plant costing runs
